## E2 — Competitive teardown: driving situations: roundabouts, metered ramps, diverging diamond interchanges, traffic stops, deer and funeral processions
No competitor was reviewed in this pass; names, prices, structure, pedagogy, practice style, praise, complaints and coverage are open (WI-SITUATIONS-TEARDOWN).
Adopt and beat lists stay empty until at least two named, priced competitors are examined from their own store or review pages.
Angle to test later: competitors may ignore Wisconsin's deer-crash steps and ramp meters; covering the state's own deer tag and keeping rules could be a beat point once verified.
